info.name: Automation Anywhere API Task Execution AccessDetails LockerConsumers API

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Returns all roles that have consumer access to the credentials in the specified Locker. Consumer roles are used by bots to retrieve credential values during automation execution.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

items.docs: Grants a role consumer access to the credentials in the specified Locker. Bots assigned to this role can then retrieve credential values from this Locker during execution.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique numeric identifier of the locker

params.name: roleId
params.description: Numeric ID of the consumer role to remove

items.docs: Revokes a role's consumer access to the credentials in the specified Locker. Bots assigned to this role will no longer be able to retrieve credential values through this Locker.
